title: Find the mob nobody is fighting
summary: When your group is in combat but nobody has dealt or taken damage for 5 seconds, Stray Ping finds the stray mob, tells the party and pings it.

steps.say: Your group pulls a quilboar camp. Gorrak charges in.
The Quilboar is down, but the Hunter that joined the fight stands back where nobody sees it. The group stays in combat.
After 5 seconds with no damage, Stray Ping finds the stray mob and says so, in your chat and in party chat.

expect.chat: Razormane Hunter has nobody on it

steps.say: The game doesn't let addons ping on their own, so the ping button lights up instead.
One click puts an Attack ping on the Hunter, so the group can see where it is.
Bind it to a key in Key Bindings > AddOns to ping without reaching for the mouse.
